description:
**FLAMEBOURNE SMP**

Looking for an SMP where your progress actually matters? FlameBourneSMP is a long-term Java & Bedrock survival server built around community, exploration, progression, and a player-driven economy.

**NO RESETS • NO P2W **

Our main world never resets, so the base, town, shop, or kingdom you build today can still be there years from now. A separate Resource World resets regularly, keeping materials plentiful without sacrificing the history of the main world. Land claiming and grief protection keep your builds safe.

**ADVENTURE & PROGRESSION**

• 1,600+ Quests & Daily Quests 

• 200+ Custom Enchantments 

• EliteMobs, Custom Bosses & challenging combat 

• mcMMO progression 

• Additional structures & places to explore 

• Custom powerful gear earned through gameplay 

**PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY**

• Jobs & multiple ways to earn money 

• Player Shops & Chest Shops 

• Player Orders 

• Auction House 

• Player Warps 

• Strictly NO PAY-TO-WIN

**CUSTOM FISHING**

Catch 300+ custom fish, progress through an expanded fishing system, earn rewards, and compete in server-wide fishing tournaments.

**BUILD & CREATE**

Protect your land and create something permanent with custom furniture, decorative blocks, flowers, skulls, expanded building options, and much more.

**MORE TO DISCOVER**

• Java & Bedrock Crossplay 

• Custom Emojis 

• Daily Login Rewards 

• Vote Rewards 

• Custom Menus 

• Homes & RTP 

• Teams & Toggleable PvP 

• Chat Games, Tags & Colors 

• Player-run Shops 

• Pets, Cosmetics & more 

FlameBourne isn't about rushing through a temporary season and starting over. Build a home. Start a town. Open a shop. Fight bosses. Complete quests. Make friends. Leave your mark on a world that lasts.

Forge your legacy. Let your legend burn bright.
